description:
Fixes the Petal Maps 4.8.0.300 startup crash (NoSuchMethodError) and keeps the app working without HMS Core: WebView H5 login, no HMS dialog and no forced close.

- **Anti-Repack Bypass**: neutralises the native SecurityDetect.irpj() integrity check that kills the process on re-signed APKs.
- **Manufacturer Check Bypass**: removes the Huawei/Honor-only device gate, allowing Petal Maps to run on any Android device.
- **Huawei Login Fix**: forces the Account Picker sign-in path, which uses the WebView H5 fallback when HMS Core is missing.
- **Skip HMS Core checks**: suppresses the "HMS Core not installed" dialog and prevents the app from closing the map activity without HMS Core.
- **Change package name**: install alongside the original app (default: morphe.huawei.petal.maps).

patches.name: AccountPicker WebView force
patches.description: Forces AccountPickerSignInHubPresenter to always use the WebView H5 login path, bypassing HMS Core availability checks that fail on non-Huawei devices.

patches.name: Anti-Repack Bypass
patches.description: Neutralizes the native integrity check (SecurityDetect.irpj) that kills the process upon detecting APK re-signing.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Changes the package name from com.huawei.maps.app to morphe.huawei.petal.maps by default, allowing the patched app to coexist with the original. Changing the package name can lead to unexpected issues.

options.description: The package name to rename the app to. Leave as 'Default' to use morphe.huawei.petal.maps.
Update custom permissions declared by the app. Required for Petal Maps coexistence.
Update provider authorities declared by the app. Required for Petal Maps coexistence.

patches.name: Huawei login fix
patches.description: Forces the Account Picker sign-in path (b.n) in AccountFactory, which uses the WebView H5 sign-in fallback when HMS Core is missing.

patches.name: Main activity orientation fix
patches.description: Changes PetalMapsActivity's screenOrientation from "behind" to "unspecified", allowing the app to rotate freely.

patches.name: Manufacturer Check Bypass
patches.description: Forces the Huawei manufacturer check to always return true, allowing non-Huawei devices to use the app.

patches.name: Skip HMS Core checks
patches.description: Skips the HMS Core availability prompt and prevents Petal Maps from closing the map activity when HMS Core is missing.

release_notes: Fixes Petal Maps 4.8.0.300 startup crash (NoSuchMethodError in AccountFactory). Works without HMS Core: H5 WebView login, no HMS dialog, no forced close.
repoDescription: Morphe/ReVanced patch that adds Android Auto support to Petal Maps (reuses the built-in HiCar automotive UI)
